FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Deep Oversold RSI Signals Potential Rebound Amid Safe-Haven Flows
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades heavily below its 20-day moving average at 159.01, reflecting sustained risk-off and safe-haven JPY demand.
RSI-14 has plunged to 28.86, signaling extreme short-term oversold conditions and a high probability of a technical mean-reversion bounce.
Broad USD selling across G10 currencies, combined with geopolitical tensions, caps any immediate USD recovery attempts.

FX.comment: Deeply oversold RSI at 28.86 signals a high-probability tactical rebound toward the 159.00 MA20 resistance.
